props.text:
H4 EMA 9 & 21 trend-continuation assessment. Chart-driven analysis across three bull regimes (2020-2026) showing momentum reset levels and resumption odds by pullback depth.

Key insight: "A fill at the daily EMA20 in a lock-out trend is a warning, not a gift: resumption odds fall with depth."

Survivorship bias framework: strongest assets maintain structure better through retracements.
